result:
I wrote the 3분기 answers to `answer.json`, but I haven't checked them. The project's CLAUDE.md says not to verify results or compare them with reference values, so I didn't re-run the 2분기 calculation against the values you gave.

| 항목 | 값 |
|---|---|
| a. 순매출 1위 세그먼트 / 순매출 | `smb` / 301,346,955 |
| b. 결제 완료 주문이 있는 고객 수 | 295 |
| c. 순매출 1위 카테고리 / 순매출 | `svc` / 408,758,420 |
| d. 순매출이 가장 큰 달 | 2025-09 |
| e. 환불액 합계 1위 고객 | u26@ex.com |
| f. 결제 완료 주문 2건 이상 고객 수 | 277 |
| g. 주문당 평균 순매출 | 713,555 |
| h. 8월 대비 9월 증가율 | 29.1% |

How I applied the definitions:
- **세그먼트 이름:** the DB stores them inconsistently (`SMB`, `Enterprise `, ` consumer` and so on), so I trimmed spaces and lowercased them before grouping.
- **기간:** `ordered_at` is always in UTC (`...Z`), so the quarter is 2025-07-01 00:00 up to, but not including, 2025-10-01, in UTC.
- **반올림:** amounts are rounded down at each line, as you defined. h uses half-up rounding.
- **g의 분모:** the divisor is every 3분기 결제 완료 주문 in the `orders` table. If any of those orders have no line items, they still count, which would make g lower than an average over orders with items only.

STATUS: PARTIAL
